name: BBQ Chicken Thighs with Romaine, Avocado, Corn & Creamy Ranch Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, and spices in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads romaine lettuce
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Place ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide salad and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
